rows.note: GDD 12.9: a militant faction borders a weaker holding; the holding falls if it lapses. Fortify steps are factions.params fortify-gain 15 and raid-damage 25; 40 is the defence a faction's last holding loses instead of falling (factions.params last-holding-damage). Chance provisional.
GDD 12.9: a faction's leading notable dies; it splits in two if it lapses, led by the least loyal claimant. The loyalty steps and the lapses of the first two stages are provisional.
GDD 12.9: a cold snap for 5 world days across three regions; sickness in every settlement there if it lapses. Gauge steps provisional.
GDD 12.9 and 4.13: the ring's core opens; it stays open for a season if it lapses. Seal it with goods and beats; go through counts distinct characters on the core tile. Threat steps provisional.

GDD 4.13 and 12.6: a relay tower of the ring of eight wakes, the one nearest the busiest settlement, while the core is shut. Every world has the ring, so the director casts it when no other world template fits, and every season has its world arc. Threat in its regions if it lapses, which the finale reads. Tags and gauge steps provisional.
GDD 12.6: a finale cast from the largest unresolved pressure, here a region's threat and corruption over their lines. Gauge steps provisional.
GDD 12.6: a finale cast from the largest unresolved pressure, here a faction's grudges. The fortify step is factions.params raid-damage; 14 grudge days provisional.
GDD 12.6: a finale cast from the largest unresolved pressure, here a settlement's lost troubles. The mend is settlements.params reopen-share's 25; gauge steps provisional.

GDD 12.9: corruption over 500 that has joined up; it spreads a day at a time for story.params front-spread-days if it lapses. Read on region gauges, as the sim has no tile corruption. Days and steps provisional.
GDD 12.9: two settlements within 12 tiles, both growing; the smaller loses prosperity if it lapses. Steps provisional.
GDD 4.6: a notable under factions.params defect-below wavers; the rival is the faction most hostile to theirs. Steps provisional.
GDD 4.5: a faction betrayed another within story.params betrayal-days. The fortify step is factions.params raid-damage; the threat step provisional.
GDD 4.3: a region past its overrun line beside an open place. Steps provisional.
GDD 4.3: scarcity past its yields line where a place stands; a shortage in every place there if it lapses. Steps provisional.
GDD 12.9: a notable was helped, or wronged, by the character; their disposition hardens if it lapses. The seat is the NPC's home. Steps provisional.
GDD 12.9: a character comes back after 14 world days away; their orders and claims lapse if it lapses. Home is the last place visited. Steps provisional.
GDD 12.8: an oath, cast from a broken vow at the board it was sworn on. Steps provisional.
GDD 12.8: a notable who lost to the character's side. Steps provisional.

GDD 12.9: a region's road load reaches emergence.params road-war-load within road-war-days and a faction not holding it holds a region within story.params rival-distance. Patrol and cut last emergence.params patrol-days and cut-days, the lapse's toll toll-days. Steps provisional.

GDD 12.9: a caravan's road ahead crosses a region at emergence.params caravan-threat; it halts while the arc runs. A salvage splits its goods among that side's backers; a lapse leaves them in its tile's spoils. Steps provisional.

GDD 17.6: two live First-mode goals for different guilds race for one thing in one region, each with emergence.params opposed-contributors. A side's goods are the goals' tag when they share one. Steps provisional.
GDD 13.2: a legend gets a place in the director's cast; an unlaid one not cast within emergence.params legend-rest-days, in an awake region with an open place. Steps provisional.
GDD 4.5 and 12.9: syndicate standing at the gate; the nearest den's fence asks, and its captain stands behind it. Taking the job at the fence makes the character.
GDD 12.9: a watch captain near a den meets a crooked or made character. Naming the fence informs; if it lapses the den moves and nothing is said.
